title: Boat Day: is it a good morning for the boat?
summary: Grades the next 7 mornings as GREAT/GOOD/MARGINAL/NO for boating, using two weather models for wind and gusts, swell and chop, plus Bureau of Meteorology coastal warnings. It can email you when a good day is coming.
how_to_use: Ask "is it a good boat day this week?". Change the location and thresholds in the script.
requires: Free APIs, no keys. Set up for Perth (Two Rocks), so change the coordinates for your area.
